claim: Cloudflare Pages sends `Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate` for static assets unless _headers says otherwise, with ETags for revalidation
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/configuration/serving-pages/ (updated 2026-04-21): '"Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate" is sent for cacheable assets'; 'Pages always sends Etag headers for 200 OK responses'. Basis of PERF-02.

Same page: 'Pages will also serve Gzip and Brotli responses whenever possible.' Gzip is therefore the conservative measure (the shared chunks are 15% smaller in brotli: 1d7v06l7cauxb.js 69.9 KiB gz, 59.8 br).

claim: Pages Free: 20,000 files per site, 25 MiB per file, 500 builds per month, 20-minute build timeout
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/pages/platform/limits/ (updated 2026-09-05) states all four. Today's export: 608 files, largest out/media/raha-drone-opening_landscape.mp4 11,412,723 bytes (45% of the limit); _headers has 9 rules of the 100 allowed.

claim: Turnstile: tokens expire after 300 s, and Cloudflare recommends running the script as early as possible on page entry
evidence: https://developers.cloudflare.com/turnstile/get-started/client-side-rendering/ (updated 2026-06-17): 'Tokens expire after 300 seconds (5 minutes)'; it recommends running the script early so verification completes. Its `execution: 'execute'` mode defers the challenge, not the script download.

`node scripts/check-export.mjs` on today's export prints 'OK 59 required files present' (P08 added checkout/return, orders, notify/confirm, notify/unsubscribe, admin orders, reconciliation, notifications).

claim: VideoTile 'never loads a byte before the tap: preload="none"'
evidence: True for the film (no .mp4 request in any run), false for its poster: every poster is fetched at parse time (m-desk.json /started: 7 poster requests at 58 ms). See PERF-04.

claim: Only the faces the design uses are declared, so no other file is ever downloaded
evidence: No run requested a Light face (m-desk.json, m-mob.json: only the 5 declared files). The two Light files are still deployed in out/fonts/thmanyah but referenced by nothing (refs.mjs).

claim: check:budgets measures exactly the chunks a page's HTML references, and that is the first-party JavaScript a visitor downloads
evidence: Network capture on 22 public pages (m-desk.json): every /_next/static script requested at load is one of the HTML's script tags and none is fetched later on scroll; the budget's numbers match my gzip of the same files. The only extra script at load is third-party Turnstile on /contact and /orders (PERF-01).
